description: This Java class 'IncludeOverlay' renders masks to partially hide everything outside the bounds of included views in an Android layout editor. It is used for visualizing included files within a different context, masking out regions outside the included content.

classes.name: IncludeOverlay
classes.description: A class that renders masking overlays to highlight included views in an Android layout editor.

methods.name: IncludeOverlay
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the overlay with a given OverlayContainer.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Overrides the paint method to draw masks over regions outside included views.

methods.name: computeMasks
methods.description: Calculates rectangles to mask out everything except the included root views.
